# VPPA Fashions

> India's premium men's clothing brand offering luxury collections — Velocity, Presence, Power & Attitude.

## About

VPPA Fashions is a premium Indian menswear brand based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. We design and sell luxury men's clothing including sweatshirts, linen shirts, hoodies, cargo pants, and full-sleeve shirts. Our brand philosophy centers on four pillars: Velocity, Presence, Power, and Attitude.

## Collections

- [Velocity Collection](https://vppafashions.com/collection/velocity): Fast-paced, dynamic styles for the modern man
- [Presence Collection](https://vppafashions.com/collection/presence): Commanding, sophisticated pieces that make a statement
- [Power Collection](https://vppafashions.com/collection/power): Bold, structured garments for confident individuals
- [Attitude Collection](https://vppafashions.com/collection/attitude): Expressive, distinctive fashion for those who stand out

## Product Categories

- Sweatshirts & Hoodies
- Linen Shirts
- Full-Sleeve Shirts
- Cargo Pants
- T-Shirts
